# OpenSwing reference selection

Selected unmodified files from TU Delft's Vortex Step Method, retained for
source inspection. This directory is not a complete installation or a browser
dependency. `SOURCE.json` records the revision, URLs, hashes and retrieval
failure for an initially guessed documentation path. `LICENSE` is the upstream
MIT license.

See [the formulation review](../../docs/validation/vortex-step-method-review-20261030.md)
for findings and limits. In particular, this solver is not a reference ASWING
executable, and its core, vortex geometry and section closure differ.
